verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a subscription billing platform, since self-hostable billing systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Recurly can be deployed on a user's own infrastructure. The hosted Engage sandbox and the standalone retry engine that plugs into an existing billing stack are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
